title: Enigma Teessoo Fagoo
intro: Mootiin humna guddaa qabu tokko, bulchiinsa adda taʼeen eebbifame, qormaata addaa mootittii biyya fagoo irraa dhufte hirmaachisu isa mudate. Mootiin kun humnaa fi ogummaa waaqummaa agarsiisuu kan barbaade yoo ta’u, taatee ajaa’ibaa seera yeroo fi bakka cabsu sochii keessa galche. Taatee dinqii kanaa balʼinaan hubachuu dandeessaa?
clues: Bulchaan tokko uumamtoota hin mul’anne to’achuu fi qilleensa ajajuu dabalatee aangoo guddaan kennameefii ture.
Bulchaan kun oduu mootittii dureettii aduu waaqeffattu argate, mana murtiittis ishee afeeruuf murteesse.
Mootittiin osoo hin dhufin dura, bulchaan kun teessoo aangoo ishee dinqisiisaa mootummaa ishee fagoo irraa fiduuf fedhii akka qabu ibseera.
Jinni jabaan tokko osoo bulchaan yaa’ii isaa keessaa hin ka’iin meeshaa sana deebifachuuf of dhiheesse.
Haataʼu malee, namni beekumsa gadi fagoo Caaffata Qulqullaaʼoo Waaqummaa qabu tokko, hojii sana ija jaamsuudhaan xumuruudhaan, kana caalaa dafee akka argatu dhiheesse.
Bulchaan kun yeroo dhufu meeshaan sun akka jijjiiramu ajaje, kunis sammuu fi hubannoo mootittii yeroo dhumarratti masaraa mootummaa geesse.
verse: It was said to her, "Enter the palace." But when she saw it, she thought it was a body of water and uncovered her shins. He said, "Indeed, it is a palace paved with glass." She said, "My Lord, indeed I have wronged myself, and I submit with Solomon to Allah, Lord of the worlds." (An-Naml 27:44)
arabic: قِيلَ لَهَا ادْخُلِي الصَّرْحَ ۖ فَلَمَّا رَأَتْهُ حَسِبَتْهُ لُجَّةً وَكَشَفَتْ عَن سَاقَيْهَا ۚ قَالَ إِنَّهُ صَرْحٌ مُّمَرَّدٌ مِّن قَوَارِيرَ ۗ قَالَتْ رَبِّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي وَأَسْلَمْتُ مَعَ سُلَيْمَانَ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
